excerpt: We set lower limits on the partial lifetime for each of these modes: tau/B(p -> e+ pi0) > 2.4 x 10^34 years and tau/B(p -> mu+ pi0) > 1.6 x 10^34 years at 90% confidence level.
title: Search for proton decay via p -> e+ pi0 and p -> mu+ pi0 with an enlarged fiducial volume in Super-Kamiokande I-IV
